summary.text: Landon Dooley is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran, rancher and small-business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports public safety, secure elections and responsible management of state lands and forests.

paragraphs.text: Landon Dooley served in the U.S. Army from 2004 to 2012 and works in business management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a combat veteran, rancher, husband, father and small-business owner who was raised in a family business.
He said he and his wife are raising their children in northern New Mexico.
Dooley advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
He said he would serve constituents across Colfax, Mora, Rio Arriba, San Miguel and Taos counties.

His stated priorities include ending what he called the revolving door for violent repeat offenders, supporting law enforcement, parents' rights in education, secure elections and wildfire prevention.
